# Firmware bench log

Readings from the test bench, one night at a time. This note carries no tag:
its `up:` front matter alone files it under Receiver firmware, so its first
line in the editor reads Projects › Ghostline Relay › Receiver firmware ›
Firmware bench log.

## Night one

Twelve hours on the bench receiver. Two pings crossed the threshold, both
from the maintenance drone on its usual round, and both were logged and
dismissed by hand.

## Night two

The aggregate counter rolled over at midnight and started again from zero,
which is what it should do.
